name: v4.3.0
body:
## What's Changed
* feat(polymarket): lead entity topics with their most interesting markets by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1487
* fix(polymarket): match descriptive topics across simple plurals by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1492
* fix(polymarket): report partial searches and bound them by the stream deadline by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1493
* test(planner): pin drill plans keeping polymarket_hints; share one hint cap by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1494
* fix(jobs): find secret job signals on company runs by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1491
* chore(release): bump version to 4.3.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1496


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/compare/v4.2.1...v4.3.0
